summary: Bearer token restricted to https *.slack.com (remote-file SSRF rejected with test), replace_all destructive gate via single-use preflight id, write authority never minted for shared-in canvases, IPC strict field allowlist and byte/codepoint bounds; vendored companion gate hardened to a provable read-only grammar (verb+option allowlists, expansion/glob/pager denial).
residual_risks: Companion gate soundness rests on deny-on-unverifiable; future companion verbs/flags must be allowlisted deliberately.
